_retrieval_text: Document Uploads Fail for Files Over 100 MB in Production – APAC Region Large file uploads fail with a 'request size exceeds limit' error message. This issue affects document uploads in the production environment of the APAC region. The web server request size limit was incorrectly configured to 100MB, preventing larger files from being uploaded. This issue may occur after recent infrastructure changes or maintenance activities. Increasing the Apache request limit resolved the issue. Login Fails After Password Reset for Users in Production – US Region Users are unable to log in after performing a password reset, receiving an 'invalid credentials' error despite successful password reset process. This issue affects users in the production – US region. Authentication cache was not refreshing after password updates, causing login failures. In some cases, clearing the authentication cache and restarting the authentication service may resolve the issue automatically. If not, users can try resetting their password and attempting to log in again. Portal Page Loading Issues The portal page may not load properly, causing a spinning wheel or slow loading times. This can impact users' ability to access important information and perform tasks. The issue may be caused by a browser-related problem, such as a slow connection or outdated browser version. Edge cases include users experiencing issues with search response times. In these cases, clearing browser cache and refreshing the page can help resolve the issue. Backup Jobs Fail for Files Over 100 MB Invoices may not generate due to failed backups, resulting in data loss and potential revenue impact. The issue occurs when files exceed the configured size limit, causing the backup service to fail. Edge cases: If the backup job fails due to network issues or disk space constraints, restart the service after resolving the underlying cause. Additionally, ensure that the role and queue are updated correctly to avoid further failures.
